name: Claude Code

programmable_control: Start: `claude -p "<prompt>" --output-format stream-json --allowedTools ... --permission-mode ...` (also `--bare`, `--effort`, `--model`, `--max-budget-usd`, `--bg`, `--cloud`); Check/resume: `claude --resume <session-id> -p "<prompt>"`, `claude -c -p "<prompt>"`, `claude agents --json`, `claude auth status`; Stop: SIGTERM terminates the Bash process tree, runs SessionEnd hooks, and exits 143; also controllable via Python/TS Agent SDK. Docs: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/headless and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference
auth_method: CLI OAuth login (`claude auth login`, `claude setup-token`), `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (required in `--bare` mode), or AWS Bedrock / Google Vertex AI / Microsoft Foundry credentials
usage_or_limits: Organization-level API: `GET https://api.anthropic.com/v1/organizations/usage_report/claude_code` (Admin API / Enterprise Analytics API; not available to individual accounts); per-run cost/tokens in `--output-format json` / `stream-json` and `--max-budget-usd` cap. Docs: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/claude-code-analytics-api
pricing_model: Subscription or pay-as-you-go API; no free tier for Claude Code (Claude Free $0 excludes Claude Code; Pro $20/mo or $17/mo annual, Max $100/mo, Ultra $200/mo, Team/Enterprise, or API token billing)
fit_reason: Gold-standard headless CLI (`-p`, `stream-json`, `--resume`, `--effort`, clean SIGTERM tree cleanup); already built into OpenWiz's local driver.
